changelog:
Initial release of Generate Healthcare Ad Creative Brief skill.

- Enables planning of campaign visuals and hooks for healthcare promotions.
- Designed for paid campaign planning by healthcare operators, clinic teams, and patient educators.
- Guides users through clarifying goals, audience, and constraints for effective briefs.
- Integrates with SkillBoss capabilities to enrich campaign assets and supporting data.
- Utilizes chat and image generation APIs for draft creation and visual concepts.
- Emphasizes human review before publishing patient-facing or regulated content.
